new.name: AskSolique
new.description: AskSolique is an AI research workspace for India tax and company law. It answers from primary sources across income tax, GST, FEMA, corporate law, SEBI and customs, and it can turn that research into a deliverable. Browsing the regulatory library costs 0 credits. A 7-day trial needs no card. Paid use, quoted exclusive of GST on 20 Nov 2026, is a pack at ₹999 for 4,000 credits or ₹3,999 a month for 16,000 credits.
new.pricing_detail: 7-day trial, no card. Pay as you go ₹999 + GST for 4,000 credits (7 days). Pro ₹3,999 + GST/mo for 16,000 credits (asksolique.ai/pricing, 20 Nov 2026).

new.name: Venbit Content Agent
new.description: Venbit Content Agent is an AI writer for small-business websites: it reads your site so the article sounds like your business, plans the piece with you, offers two outlines, then writes the one you pick, hero image included, ready to copy, download or publish. Your first article is free. Venbit also runs a free AI Visibility check that asks ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini who they recommend for your trade and city and scores each answer. It is part of Venbit's software for local businesses, whose plans start at $39 a month after a one-month trial.

new.name: AI Sales Trainer
new.description: AI Sales Trainer from Sandwich lets salespeople rehearse with a virtual customer before a real meeting: you describe the customer, the offer, the goal and the likely objections, then practise by text or voice and get feedback after each attempt. A skills roadmap covers first contact, needs discovery, presenting a solution, handling objections, negotiation and closing, with adjustable difficulty, multi-participant negotiations, exams without hints and progress views for managers. It is available in English, Russian, Spanish, German and French.

new.name: BeatMV
new.description: BeatMV is an AI music video generator: upload a track or paste a link (including Suno or Udio songs), pick a visual style, and it plans a storyboard and cuts a finished video in minutes, with no editing skills needed. Other tools cover lyric videos, dance videos from a photo, music visualizers, Spotify Canvas loops, AI character and fashion-show clips, MP3 to MP4 and video upscaling. New users get free credits; personal plans start at $19.90 a month.

new.name: BeatMusic
new.description: BeatMusic is an online AI music studio: it generates royalty-free songs, background tracks, rap and sound effects in any genre or mood, and adds editing tools such as AI covers, remixing, adding vocals to a track, extending songs, vocal removal, stem splitting, lyrics generation, voice cloning and album cover art. There is also a music agent and an API for developers. Paid plans start at about $17.90 a month billed yearly and include a commercial licence; one-time credit packs are also sold.

new.name: Sabriel AI
new.description: Sabriel AI is a WordPress chatbot plugin from Sabriel Agency that answers website visitors in their own language around the clock, under your brand, using your own AI provider key (Gemini, for example). The free version gives the full chat on unlimited sites with no card; paid plans add appointment booking, PDF quotes, lead qualification and other automations, at $12, $25 or $49 a month (or one-time licences). AI usage is billed separately by the provider you choose.

new.name: Promptclay
new.description: Promptclay is a community library of AI image prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini (Nano Banana) and other image models: you browse a feed of example images, copy the prompt, and swap in your own photo, with themed collections such as game loading-screen portraits. Creators can share prompts, follow others and save collections for free; Pro ($10 a month after a 3-day trial) adds a portfolio on your own domain, a leads inbox and booking.

new.name: Brigade.lol
new.description: Brigade (brigade.lol) is a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that gives you a team of AI teammates for coding, customer support, marketing and lead follow-up, each running the real Claude Code or Codex signed in with your own Claude or ChatGPT plan, so Brigade never bills for AI usage. You can stack several accounts so a teammate continues on the next one when a limit is hit, give each teammate a different model, and approve decisions from one list on your phone. Free on your own computer; always-on teammates start at $15 a month.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Firecrawl is an AGPL-3.0 web data API for AI agents, open source and available as a hosted service: Search returns full page content for web results, Scrape turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, Crawl and Map cover whole sites, Interact clicks, scrolls and types before extracting, and Parse converts PDFs and DOCX files. It handles proxies, rate limits and JavaScript-heavy pages for you, and connects to any agent or MCP client with a single command.
